originalTitle: Road Rash - Official 30th Anniversary Edition Launch Trailer
content: Check out the 30th Anniversary Edition Launch Trailer for Road Rash, the arcade classic combat racing game developed by EA. Players can now access this classic for the first time digitally, with high-resolution cinematics, 60 FPS gameplay, and more. Celebrate 30 years of Road Rash, available now on PC (Steam). #IGN #gaming
chineseContent: 查看 Road Rash 30 周年纪念版发布预告片，这是 EA 开发的街机经典格斗赛车游戏。玩家现在可以首次以数字方式体验这款经典游戏，享受高分辨率的过场动画、60 FPS 的游戏体验等等。庆祝《Road Rash》诞生 30 周年，现已登陆 PC (Steam)。 #IGN #游戏
